explanation: For every real x, y²+z²=1 is a unit circle in the yz-plane. Extending this circle along the x-axis gives a circular cylinder, a special case of an elliptic cylinder.

answers.correct_value: An elliptic cylinder whose axis of symmetry is the $x$-axis
answers.wrong_value: An elliptic cylinder whose axis of symmetry is the $y$-axis
